quotes.text: No seed crosses twice for a hand that always closes upon itself.
At the river of Threefold Echoes, a silver tree held two stone cups above the water.
Mist may change what you see; it cannot change what kindness deserves.
When you gather shoots, remember whose hand opened first.
trust begins when someone risks a gift, and flourishes when its keeper shares the harvest.

note: Threefold Echoes ford; roles swap daily, fog forgiven; only R1 hints that closed hands stop receiving.

quotes.text: leaving room for uncertainty but none for spite.
At Nara’s ford, a silver tree stood between two banks, its roots drinking from the river of Threefold Echoes.
Mist belongs to the river, not to your neighbor.
Give freely when you can, and honor the risk of the one who gave.

note: Nara's ford with two stone cups; same alternating-turn story each round; no response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: Shall I punish a friend for the mist's hunger?"
The crows pressed close. "Even the score! Pay her back in kind!"
Whoever receives them, return more than half. Let the fog take its small toll, but never your faith.
In the fifth season, the five golden threads fell once more into Tomas's hands.
"The fog nibbles, not my friend."
"She cannot see through the mist. Keep more. She will never know."
"Why do you send everything, every time?" she asked.
so that his courage would never cost him.

note: Tomas and Ilka weave; crows urge keeping and evening the score each season and are ignored; verse added per season.

quotes.text: Shall I punish a friend for the river's thirst?"
"Oru sent less this time. Send back less. Let them feel it."
Doubt the mist before you doubt your neighbor. Answer every shortfall with generosity, and the river stays whole.
In the seventh season, Mira stood upstream again with Kest's full harvest.
"The mist steals, not our neighbors. Judge the long current, not one raft."
"Why do you always send everything? What if Oru keeps it all this time?"
"A full hand deserves a full answer."

note: Kest and Oru carve one line per crossing; herons and elders urge evening the score, rejected; last-round temptation refused.
